stem.text: Pigeons are birds that belong to the Columbidae family. They are distributed throughout the world.

items: The two sex chromosomes in female pigeons are known as the Z chromosome and the W chromosome.
One of the genes controlling feather colour in pigeons is located on the Z chromosome. The W chromosome does not have this gene.
This gene has three alleles, each coding for a different feather colour.
The allele for ash-red feathers is dominant to the allele for blue feathers, which is dominant to the allele for brown feathers.
